events.description: Rumsfeld memo to Gen. Myers questioning DoD's near total dependence on CIA for ground action in Afghanistan and asking for a coordinated proposal.
Rumsfeld sends a working-paper memo to Gen. Myers questioning DoD's near total dependence on the CIA for ground operations in Afghanistan and requesting a coordinated proposal.

relationships.detail: Rumsfeld says DoD cannot act on the ground in Afghanistan until CIA people go in first, a near total dependence.
relationships.quote: can't do anything on the ground in Afghanistan until CIA people go in first to prepare the way

relationships.detail: Myers is tasked by Rumsfeld to return with a coordinated proposal.
relationships.quote: please come back to me with a coordinated proposal as to what we might want to do about it

relationships.detail: Rumsfeld addressed a working-paper memo to Gen. Myers asking for a coordinated proposal on reducing DoD dependence on CIA.

key_claims: The US Defense Department in October 2001 could not operate on the ground in Afghanistan until CIA personnel had gone in first to prepare the way.
Rumsfeld questioned whether DoD should be in a position of near total dependence on CIA for such situations.
Rumsfeld asked Gen. Myers for a coordinated proposal to address this possible capability gap.
